title: Star Peak Banquet and the Ruthless Heir
summary: Ye Fan warns Zhang Wenchang not to cross Hua Yunfei, meets Li Xiaoman again (she now follows Hua Yunfei), and goes to Hua Yunfei's Star Peak banquet for the young kings of the Central States and the Eastern Wasteland, still pretending to be crippled by his Dao wounds. There he taunts Wang Chongxiao about his 'feud' with the Ji family. The guests discuss the lid of the Heaven-Swallowing Demon Jar appearing in the Yunduan Mountains, where the Ruthless Dojo was opened with special physiques' blood as a trap. Ye Fan suggests that the Ruthless heir is someone from a major holy land sitting among them, and Hua Yunfei warns him that a wounded Holy Body is a prize for that heir. On the way down, three soul clones sent by a Dao Palace expert attack him with a replica Heaven-Swallowing Demon Jar; he destroys them and follows their trail back to Star Peak, confirming his suspicion.
